facts.fact: Alf 死于周日上午 11:30，死时手在 Pamela 手中，时为 Miriam 离家八天后；死因为突发性脑溢血（"unexpected, catastrophic brain bleed"）。
facts.anchor: Alf died on a Sunday. Half past eleven in the morning, his hand in Pamela’s, and eight days after I left home. An unexpected, catastrophic brain bleed.

facts.fact: 葬礼上没有 Caswells 一家、没有 Lawrence（Pa 见到会像受伤暴怒的公牛冲上去）；Doris 压低声音捎话：Lawrence 知道自己不受欢迎但心里想着她们；Miriam 不敢把口信转告家人。
facts.anchor: No Caswells. No Lawrence. Pa would have charged him, like an injured, raging bull.

facts.fact: Miriam 把母亲娘家姓 Mott 试给 Whipple，他抓住她的手喊 "Here be Mimi Mott!"，新名字就此叫开；她因 Harold Caswell 咂念父姓 "Bramley" 而对父亲满心苦涩。
facts.anchor: When I tried out my mother’s maiden name on Whipple, he grabbed my hands. ‘That’s it, that’s you. Here be Mimi Mott!’ We laughed. It stuck.

facts.fact: Rafe 通过 Whipple 传话、把 Ladbroke Grove 合租房的阁楼给 Miriam 住；她后来得知 Rafe 自己多付钱替她压低了房租。
facts.anchor: later learned he’d knocked down my rent by paying more himself.

facts.fact: 电话里 Pamela 拒收 Miriam 想寄回家的钱："我们不需要你的钱""就算需要也绝不碰"；Miriam 在这股道德重量下自觉缩成一粒豌豆。
Lawrence 剖白：永远无法原谅自己把 Alf 带得离边缘太近，但没有推他、没有碰他（"I didn't push him or touch him"），只求 Miriam 相信。
facts.anchor: I’ll never forgive myself for getting Alf too close to the edge, Miriam, but I didn’t push him or touch him.

facts.fact: Lawrence 把 Portobello Road 市场摊上买的心形祖母绿项链送给 Miriam，说处置权完全归她（"It's yours to flush as you wish"）。
facts.anchor: ‘I perfectly understand if you want to flush it down the loo. It’s yours to flush as you wish, Miriam.’

facts.fact: Lawrence 告别下楼，Miriam 冲到楼梯扶栏喊住他；两人相拥，除那条项链外全裸（"naked but for that necklace"）。
